title.en: Types of solutions and expressing concentration

hook.en: Saline drips, ORS and the fuel in a vehicle all depend on getting the concentration exactly right.

body.en: A solution is a homogeneous mixture. The component present in the largest amount is the solvent; the others are solutes. Solutions can be gaseous, liquid or solid (air, sugar in water, brass).
body.kn: ದ್ರಾವಣ ಎಂದರೆ ಏಕರೂಪ ಮಿಶ್ರಣ. ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಪ್ರಮಾಣದಲ್ಲಿರುವುದು ದ್ರಾವಕ, ಉಳಿದವು ದ್ರಾವ್ಯಗಳು.

title.en: On the board: units of concentration

say.en: A solution is a solute spread evenly through a solvent. To use it we must say how much solute is present.
Molarity counts moles per litre of solution; molality counts moles per kilogram of solvent.
Mole fraction, mass percent and ppm are the other common ways. Mole fraction has no unit.
Let us work one: 5.85 grams of NaCl made up to 500 millilitres.
Volume changes with temperature, so molarity changes. Molality uses mass, so it does not.

narration.en: Dissolve a solute in water. Molality = moles of solute per kg of solvent, mole fraction = moles of solute ÷ total moles, mass % = mass of solute ÷ mass of solution × 100. In the box, each dot is a molecule: orange solute among blue water.
narration.kn: ನೀರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ದ್ರಾವ್ಯ ಕರಗಿಸಿ. ಮೋಲಾಲಿಟಿ = ಪ್ರತಿ kg ದ್ರಾವಕಕ್ಕೆ ದ್ರಾವ್ಯದ ಮೋಲ್; ಮೋಲ್ ಭಾಗ = ದ್ರಾವ್ಯ ಮೋಲ್ ÷ ಒಟ್ಟು ಮೋಲ್; ದ್ರವ್ಯರಾಶಿ % = ದ್ರಾವ್ಯ ÷ ದ್ರಾವಣ × 100.
